music.title: Two Coins teaser
music.prompt: Instrumental only. Suspenseful, playful storybook underscore for a children's animated YouTube Short: plucked strings, soft marimba, light taiko pulse, warm Himalayan flute colour, rising tension toward a cliffhanger ending. No vocals, no choir, no sound effects, no ambience.

sections.text: Imagine your family is starving, you only have two coins left... and instead of buying food, you spend them both on advice.
headline: HE SPENT HIS LAST
2 COINS ON...
ADVICE?! 🪙😱

sections.text: That's exactly what Papa Yeti did. A tricky magpie told him to obey respectable folk, and a wise old yak told him to always tell the Queen the truth.
headline: 2 STRANGERS.
2 SIMPLE RULES.

sections.text: Minutes later, those rules led him straight to a massive pile of gold, and landed him in front of a furious Snow Leopard Queen, accused of stealing it!
headline: TREASURE…
OR A TRAP? 👑

sections.text: Did his honesty save him, or did his jealous neighbour win? Tap the linked video below to watch the full story!
